task: Secret Box modal (MoMorph J3-4YFIpMM): logged-in /kudos viewer opens a modal from the existing 'Mở Secret Box' button, clicks the gift box, receives one weighted-random badge of 6, unopened counter decrements. Server-authoritative via Postgres SECURITY DEFINER RPC + migration 0011. Scope is /kudos only; /profile button stays disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous viewer on /kudos sees no stat rows and no kudos-open-gift button (kudos.spec.ts:43 C09 preserved).
Logged-in viewer with secretBoxUnopened === 0 sees kudos-open-gift visible but disabled; modal cannot open.
Logged-in viewer with secretBoxUnopened > 0 sees kudos-open-gift enabled; clicking it opens the Secret Box dialog.
Unopened state renders title 'KHÁM PHÁ SECRET BOX CỦA BẠN', instruction 'Click vào box để tiếp tục mở', the closed-box artwork, label 'Secretbox chưa mở' and the unopened count.
Clicking the box calls the server, reveals exactly one badge of the 6, and the unopened count decreases by exactly 1.
Reveal state renders title 'MỞ SECRET BOX THÀNH CÔNG' with the awarded badge image at intrinsic 64x64, not upscaled.
When unopened count reaches 0 inside the open modal, the instruction line is hidden and the box is no longer clickable.
The dialog closes via its X button and via Escape, following the repo's native <dialog> pattern.
Badge draw and unopened count are computed server-side; client-side tampering with the count or badge id cannot change what is persisted.
Two concurrent/double-clicked open requests never consume more boxes than the viewer is entitled to.
Entitlement equals floor(sum(kudos.heart_count where sender_id = viewer)/5) minus count of that viewer's openings.
kudos/page.tsx no longer hardcodes secretBoxOpened/secretBoxUnopened to 0; both come from the database.
pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, and the full pnpm test:e2e suite all pass; kudos.spec.ts:745-747's disabled assertion is updated to the new enabled contract.
